## context:p
These modules are already part of Artec Education:

1. For students after highschool
2. For staff (freelance or unemployed)

## context:p
Areas of interest:

1. Art
2. Media
3. Systems

## content:welcome
Welcome to the Artec Education platform! Here you will find a variety of modules designed to help you expand your skills and knowledge in various areas. Whether you are a student looking to further your education or a professional seeking to enhance your expertise, we have something for you.

Our modules cover a range of topics, including 2D game design, 3D design and print, media technology, and more. Each module is designed to be engaging and interactive, allowing you to learn at your own pace and in a way that suits your learning style.

We believe that everyone deserves access to quality education, regardless of their background or current situation. That's why our modules are open to all, and we welcome students and professionals alike to join us on this learning journey.

So, what are you waiting for? Explore our modules and find the one that best suits your interests and goals. We're excited to help you reach your full potential!
